title: Delete a static route
summary: Remove a previously added static route from the routing table. This is useful for cleaning up old routes or fixing incorrect routing configurations.

steps.explain: Delete a static route for a specific destination IP or network from the routing table.

placeholders.name: DESTINATION_IP
placeholders.description: The destination IP address or network to remove

placeholders.name: INTERFACE
placeholders.description: The network interface associated with the route

rollback.explain: Re-add the route if you need to restore it.
rollback.cmd: sudo ip route add <DESTINATION_IP> via <GATEWAY_IP> dev <INTERFACE>

placeholders.name: DESTINATION_IP
placeholders.description: The destination IP address or network

warnings: Deleting a route may disconnect you from specific networks.
Ensure you know the gateway IP if you need to restore the route.
